file_insights.changes_summary: Added date range filtering inputs and updated filter form layout
key_modifications: Added two new date input fields (date_from and date_to) to filter form
Restructured filter form grid columns from col-md-4/3/3/2 to col-md-3/2/2/2/2/1 to accommodate new inputs
Moved reset button to separate row below filter form with 'Limpar Filtros' text
Updated pagination links to preserve date_from and date_to query parameters
Updated empty state conditional to check for date_from and date_to values

patterns_discovered.description: Date range parameters (date_from, date_to) are conditionally appended to pagination links using Jinja2 conditional syntax: {% if date_from %}&date_from={{ date_from }}{% endif %}
locations: pagination links for previous, numbered, and next pages

patterns_discovered.description: Form layout uses Bootstrap grid system with column width adjustments. When adding new inputs, existing column widths were reduced proportionally (col-md-4→col-md-3, col-md-3→col-md-2)
patterns_discovered.impact: Maintains responsive design while accommodating additional filters

patterns_discovered.description: All filter form inputs use value attribute with template variables to preserve user selections: value="{{ search }}", value="{{ date_from }}", etc.
locations: search input, date inputs, and dropdown selects

patterns_discovered.description: Empty state messages check multiple filter conditions to determine if message should appear, using OR operators with all filter variables

gotchas_discovered.description: Date range parameters must be conditionally included in all pagination links. Missing from even one pagination link would break filter continuity when navigating pages.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Used conditional Jinja2 syntax to only include parameters when they have values

gotchas_discovered.description: Adding two new date input fields required recalculating the entire filter row layout. Simply adding new columns would overflow the 12-column grid without reducing existing column widths.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Adjusted col-md values from col-md-4/3/3/2 to col-md-3/2/2/2/2/1, reducing button area to icon-only

gotchas_discovered.description: Filter button was changed from 'Filtrar' text + icon to icon-only to save space. This reduces affordance clarity but was necessary for grid layout.
gotchas_discovered.observation: Should verify button tooltip or aria-label for accessibility

gotchas_discovered.description: Reset button moved from inline button group to separate row below filters. This changes user interaction pattern and requires additional markup (mt-2 margin class).
gotchas_discovered.observation: Users may not notice the separate reset button row

approach_outcome.description: Successfully added date range filtering capability to material list template
what_worked: Clean addition of two date input fields with proper naming conventions (date_from, date_to)
Consistent implementation of state preservation pattern across all filter inputs
Proper parameter propagation through pagination without breaking existing query parameters
Maintained form accessibility and styling consistency with existing Bootstrap components
approach_outcome.session_efficiency: Completed in single attempt with no rework needed
approach_outcome.code_quality: Followed existing patterns for template structure, naming conventions, and conditional rendering

recommendations.recommendation: Test date filter with pagination to ensure date_from and date_to parameters persist when navigating pages
Add aria-label="Filtrar" to filter button or add title attribute since text was removed and only icon remains
Consider adding visual feedback or tooltip to indicate that 'Limpar Filtros' button is for resetting, or move it inline with filter button using a smaller variant
Document the date format expected (HTML5 date input format: YYYY-MM-DD) in code comments or user-facing help text
Verify that backend view properly validates date_from and date_to parameters and handles edge cases (e.g., date_from > date_to)
